clauses.reason: The second sentence of section 5762(a) of title 10 is suspended, as to the number of officers recommended for promotion to captain in the Civil Engineer Corps, until June 30, 1957. The end is recorded as the stated date, inclusive; the exclusive reading, under which the suspension ends when June 30, 1957 begins, is the alternative. No held order revokes, extends or amends the suspension.

research_rationale:
EO 10687 (signed 1956-11-16 by Dwight D. Eisenhower; filed 1956-11-19, 4:30 p.m.; 21 FR 9007, Federal Register of November 21, 1956 per the held source record) is read in full from the registered text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10687.txt; its number, title and date agree with the census register (the registered span begins mid-title, which is an OCR line break). Inventory: one operative paragraph. Under section 5785(b) of title 10 of the United States Code, the second sentence of section 5762(a) of title 10, on determining how many officers the Secretary of the Navy may recommend for promotion to captain or commander in certain Corps, is suspended until June 30, 1957, to the extent that it relates to the number of officers that may be recommended for promotion to captain in the Civil Engineer Corps. First end: the stated date. Following the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on until-dates, the end is recorded as June 30, 1957, inclusive (the suspension runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when June 30, 1957 begins, is the alternative. Later instruments: a scan of every held order text for the bare number 10687 found only the order's own copies, the next order printed in the same issue (EO 10688) and unrelated page numbers. Machine searches adopted after reading their coverage notes: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121, citations of the order by number, edition through 2026-10-09, no hit), current-law:ecfr (eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk, citations by number, no hit) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes for 1937 onward plus operative sentences of saved order texts).

savings.reason: The order has no savings, pending-matter or continuing-effect wording. Recommendations for promotion to captain in the Civil Engineer Corps made while the suspension ran were completed acts under the statute, and nothing in the order keeps the suspension in force after June 30, 1957.
